//: Venue catalog for all 68 teams across High School (101–112), College (201–224), and Pro (301–332). Spec: gameplay_core.md §3.1. Generalizes the schools.json pattern with interactive venue hotspots, field dimensions (LF/LCF/CF/RCF/RF, wall heights), surfaces, capacities, colors, and announcer booth metadata for Phase 14.
